en-us.com_condom_onTarget_mouth: Put a Condom on Them by Mouth
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_hand: Have Them Put a Condom on You
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_mouth: Have Them Put a Condom on You by Mouth

en-us.com_condom_self_begin: $doer.firstname$ picks up a condom, preparing to put it on.
en-us.com_condom_self_failure: $doer.firstname$ fails to put on a condom.
en-us.com_condom_onTarget_hand_begin: $doer.firstname$ picks up a condom, preparing to put it on $receiver.firstname$.
en-us.com_condom_onTarget_hand_success: $doer.firstname$ puts the condom on $receiver.firstname$ securely by hand.
en-us.com_condom_onTarget_hand_failure: $doer.firstname$ fails to put a condom on $receiver.firstname$ by hand.
en-us.com_condom_onTarget_mouth_begin: $doer.firstname$ holds a condom between their lips and tries to roll it onto $receiver.firstname$.
en-us.com_condom_onTarget_mouth_success: $doer.firstname$ puts the condom on $receiver.firstname$ securely by mouth.
en-us.com_condom_onTarget_mouth_failure: $doer.firstname$ fails to put a condom on $receiver.firstname$ by mouth. The condom remains unused.
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_hand_begin: $doer.firstname$ hands $receiver.firstname$ a condom to put on them.
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_hand_success: $receiver.firstname$ puts the condom on $doer.firstname$ securely by hand.
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_hand_failure: $receiver.firstname$ fails to put a condom on $doer.firstname$ by hand.
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_mouth_begin: $doer.firstname$ hands $receiver.firstname$ a condom to put on them by mouth.
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_mouth_success: $receiver.firstname$ puts the condom on $doer.firstname$ securely by mouth.
en-us.com_condom_byTarget_mouth_failure: $receiver.firstname$ fails to put a condom on $doer.firstname$ by mouth. The condom remains unused.
en-us.com_condom_remove_self_begin: $doer.firstname$ reaches to take off their condom.
en-us.com_condom_remove_self_failure: $doer.firstname$ fails to take off their condom.
en-us.com_condom_remove_byTarget_begin: $doer.firstname$ asks $receiver.firstname$ to take their condom off.
